personality_one_liner: A highly legible, high-contrast utilitarian ledger designed for fast, error-free field entry under bright sunlight.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. List items minimum 56pt height for easy tapping by non-technical users on the field.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar and sticky headers over scrolling content on iOS.
dont's: Avoid on low-end Android devices (use solid surfaceSecondary fallback). Do not use on list rows or form inputs.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Role selection (Owner/Supervisor) and phone number login.

states.error: Toast or inline text showing invalid credentials

screens.layout: Clean white screen, large app logo/title. Two massive cards for 'Login as Owner' and 'Login as Supervisor' with clear iconography, followed by a simple numeric OTP entry. Safe area respected.

screens.name: OwnerDashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of all 4+ construction sites, total labour count, and aggregated billing balances.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Add your first site' CTA
states.error: Error message with 'Tap to Retry' button

screens.layout: Large numeric summary at the top (Total Billed, Total Paid, Balance). Below, a single-column list of Site Cards. Each card shows Site Name, Active Labour today, and an 'Outstanding ₹' metric. Uses SpaceGrotesk for all monetary and numeric values for structural clarity.

screens.name: SiteDetail_SupervisorView
screens.purpose: The daily workspace for a supervisor to view site status and initiate daily actions.
screens.layout: Hero background image of a construction site with a gradient scrim and site name overlaid. Below: large quick-action tiles for 'Mark Attendance', 'Add Advance Payment', and 'Site Billing'. A persistent sticky CTA at the bottom to 'Upload Daily Report' to the owner.

screens.name: LabourAttendance
screens.purpose: Rapid entry of daily attendance (Full, Half, Absent) for all labourers on a site.

states.empty: Illustration of empty hard hats with 'Add Labourers' CTA

screens.layout: Sticky header with current Date selector. A flat list of labourers. Each row contains Labour Name, Daily Wage, and a horizontal Segmented Control (Full | Half | Absent). A sticky CTA at the bottom 'Save Today's Attendance' ensures quick commitment.

screens.name: BillingLedger
screens.purpose: Track GST/Non-GST bills, amounts, and payments received for a specific site.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty ledger with 'Add First Bill' CTA

screens.layout: Summary card at top (Total Billed, Received, Balance). Followed by a chronological list of bills. Tapping 'Add Bill' opens a bottom sheet with fields: Bill No, Amount, GST Toggle (Switch), and Payment Received. Submitting adds it to the ledger.

empty_labour.alt: Yellow hard hats indicating empty workforce

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality rules. High contrast, large text, and structural layout are critical for outdoor usage.
Use SpaceGrotesk (display font) specifically for all monetary values, phone numbers, and large numeric counters. Use PlusJakartaSans for all reading text and labels.
Bilingual requirement: Ensure key labels are bilingual (e.g., 'Attendance / हाज़िरी', 'Advances / एडवांस') or accommodate simple Hindi strings if fully translated.
For the Attendance screen, use a Segmented Control pattern (Full / Half / Absent) on each labourer's row to allow rapid, 1-tap data entry. DO NOT use dropdowns or multiple screens per labourer.
Ensure 'Sticky primary CTAs' are implemented on all scrolling data-entry screens (e.g., 'Save Attendance', 'Upload Report') above the home indicator.
Ensure monetary values properly format in Indian Rupees (₹).
Any text overlaid on 'site_hero_bg' MUST use a gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top-to-bottom transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast.
For low-end Android field devices, implement graceful fallback for glassmorphism to solid 'surfaceSecondary'.
